test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In April 2025, India implemented a standardised curriculum in Himalayan Buddhist monasteries. What was the primary objective of this initiative?

options.text: To integrate modern subjects alongside traditional teachings
To convert monasteries into secular schools
To reduce the number of monasteries in border areas

solution:
The Correct answer is __**To integrate modern subjects alongside traditional teachings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary objective of implementing a **standardised curriculum** in Himalayan Buddhist monasteries was to **integrate modern education** with traditional Buddhist teachings.
 
• This initiative aims to equip monks and students with knowledge in **modern subjects** like **science, mathematics, and technology**, alongside their spiritual and philosophical studies.
 
• The program also seeks to enhance the overall **educational standards** in monasteries and help the monastic community adapt to **contemporary socio-economic challenges**.
 
• Introducing modern subjects ensures that students in monasteries remain competitive and can contribute effectively to **national development** while preserving their **cultural and spiritual heritage**.
 
• This initiative reflects the Indian government's efforts to promote a more **holistic and inclusive education system** in remote areas, particularly in the **Himalayan region**.
 
• The move also aligns with India's broader aim of fostering **educational equity** and ensuring that all communities, including those in monasteries, receive access to quality education.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **To promote Chinese language education**__

 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the initiative was focused on integrating **modern subjects** with traditional Buddhist teachings rather than promoting any specific foreign language like **Chinese**.
 
• Chinese language education is typically associated with China's efforts in cultural diplomacy through programs like **Confucius Institutes**, not India's monastic curriculum.
 
 
 
• **To convert monasteries into secular schools**__
 __
 
• This option is incorrect because the initiative aimed to **enhance the existing monastic education system**, not replace it with a **secular school structure**.
 
• The focus was on **preserving traditional Buddhist teachings** while complementing them with modern subjects.
 
 
 
• **To reduce the number of monasteries in border areas**__
 
 
• This option is incorrect as the initiative was intended to **support monasteries** by upgrading their educational standards, not to reduce their presence.
 
• The monasteries play a crucial role in maintaining the **cultural and spiritual identity** of the Himalayan region.
